review.notes: No GOAT variant exists; the baseline is the pre-errata variant 511002853, whose cdb text matches lineage v5 except that the cdb writes "600 ATK/DEF" where v5 prints "600 ATK and DEF" (ratio 0.9925). The packet's second upstream code, 511019003 "Z-Metal Tank (Manga)", is NOT a candidate historical implementation: script is null and its cdb text is a manga flavour description (text ratio 0.24 against the lineage), i.e. an unofficial manga-continuity entry, not a second implementation of the TCG card - so neither the +/-10 artwork-variant fold nor the upstream-duplication escalation applies, and 511002853 is used unambiguously. All four behavioural differences were verified in the checked-out sources at C:\Users\leona\.cache\retroformats\repos\cardscripts\proc_union.lua: aux.AddUnionProcedure(c,f,oldequip,oldprotect) branches on the old-Union flag in Auxiliary.UnionFilter (ct1==0 vs ct2==0), Auxiliary.UnionSumTarget/UnionSumOperation (POS_FACEUP_ATTACK vs POS_FACEUP), Auxiliary.UnionReplace (REASON_BATTLE only vs REASON_BATTLE or REASON_EFFECT), and the IsUnionState gating of the unequip and destroy-substitute effects, which the card script mirrors on the ATK/DEF boost via e1:SetCondition(aux.IsUnionState). Lineage v0 (MFC-006, 2003-10-10) through v5 are behaviourally identical in everything the script encodes and are therefore not recorded as changes: v0 -> v1 (DR1-EN061, 2005-03-19) reframes "change it back to a monster" as "unequip the Union equipment and Special Summon this card", v2 (undated) and v3 (DP2-EN007, 2006-02-08) and v4 (DPKB-EN012, 2010-04-16) are wording, v5 is PSCT with an explicit "Target 1" that matches the EFFECT_FLAG_CARD_TARGET the union equip effect already carries in both scripts. Trailing cosmetic after the recorded change: v6 -> v7 (LCKC-EN007, 2018-03-08) is "ATK and DEF" -> "ATK/DEF", and v7 is the pinned modern text (ratio 1.0). EdisonFormat.com's entry "Machina Gearframe (and all Union Monsters)" independently attributes removal of the Condition to Structure Deck: Seto Kaiba, exactly the lineage's v6 printing (SDKS-EN007, 2016-10-20); the chronology anchor used is the lineage set-release, not the community page. The quote in external_citations is taken from the supplied transcription edison-functional-errata.md rather than from a live fetch of the page.

effective.basis: TCG release of the first printing carrying the errata'd text (SDKS-EN007, Structure Deck: Seto Kaiba); EdisonFormat.com independently attributes the Union Condition removal to the same product

event.historical_text: Once per turn, you can either: Target 1 "X-Head Cannon" or "Y-Dragon Head" you control; equip this card to that target, OR: Unequip this card and Special Summon it in face-up Attack Position. While equipped by this effect, the equipped monster gains 600 ATK and DEF. (A monster can only be equipped with 1 Union monster at a time. If the equipped monster would be destroyed by battle, destroy this card instead.)
event.modern_text: Once per turn, you can either: Target 1 "X-Head Cannon" or "Y-Dragon Head" you control; equip this card to that target, OR: Unequip this card and Special Summon it. A monster equipped with this card gains 600 ATK and DEF, also if the equipped monster would be destroyed by battle or card effect, destroy this card instead.
event.summary: Union erratum with four concrete behavioural parts, all visible in both the text lineage and the script: the pre-errata script passes the old-Union flag to aux.AddUnionProcedure and additionally gates the 600 ATK/DEF boost behind aux.IsUnionState, so in the era build (a) the equip target may not already carry a Union monster (Auxiliary.UnionFilter's ct1==0 branch, the printed Condition "A monster can only be equipped with 1 Union monster at a time"), (b) the destruction replacement covers destruction by battle only (Auxiliary.UnionReplace's old branch returns true for REASON_BATTLE alone), (c) the boost, the unequip effect and the replacement all require the union state - this card must have equipped itself with its own effect - matching "While equipped by this effect", and (d) the unequip Special Summon is forced to POS_FACEUP_ATTACK. The modern card drops the Condition, replaces destruction by battle or card effect, boosts whatever it is equipped to however it got there ("A monster equipped with this card gains 600 ATK/DEF"), and is Special Summoned in either face-up position.
